about.label: About me
about.heading: Never just one thing.
about.body:
I'm Sara. I'm 22, I'm from Aveiro, and I'm building something, I don't know exactly what yet, but I know it's going to be big.

I love creating. Turning ideas into real things, videos, websites, campaigns, or just an idea that wouldn't leave my head until I made it exist.

I'm scared of being mediocre. Of one day looking back and realising I stayed comfortable when I could have taken more risks. That fear is what keeps me going.

@sarapresaa was born from that, from the need to document, to be honest, to show that the path isn't linear and that's okay.

I'm an IT student, content creator, digital marketing and web enthusiast, and I genuinely believe creativity and technology together are the most powerful combination there is.

timeline.label: My journey
timeline.heading: Where I came from. Where I'm going.

items.title: 10 years at the Conservatory
items.description: I studied organ and classical singing at the Aveiro Music Conservatory alongside school. For 10 years I learned that discipline, patience and creativity always go hand in hand.

items.title: First professional experiences
items.description: I worked at Zara (Inditex), a call centre and my family's hair salon. I learned to deal with people, pressure and completely different environments. Nothing was wasted.

items.title: Information Technology, ESTGA
items.description: I started my IT degree at the University of Aveiro. I discovered web development, UI/UX, databases, digital marketing. I realised this is where everything made sense.

items.title: @sarapresaa was born
items.description: I created my personal brand and started documenting the journey publicly. Content, UGC, strategy and branding, all alongside university. The real-time laboratory.

items.title: Building
items.description: Another year of my degree. Developing this site, preparing for my internship, growing @sarapresaa and figuring out where I want to go. I don't know everything yet, and that's okay.

items.title: What comes next
items.description: A curricular internship at a company that unites technology and creativity. And then? My own digital ecosystem to help other creators build brands with real impact.
